set.body: Goal: after the hardening spine lands, codify the target-10 expansion as a separate epic rather than mixing speculative semantics into the cleanup. Acceptance: inspect the hardened graphics API; decide scope and ordering for typed stats (Stat as a typed data transform with its own computed aesthetics, replacing the declared-but-rejected Stat.Count), coordinate systems (flip and fixed-ratio first; polar only if a real consumer exists), facets/panel grids on top of the layout solver's named regions, position adjustments (dodge/stack/jitter), remaining geoms (rect/ribbon/errorbar/segments -- Geom.Rect is currently declared but rejected at compile), a Theme type centralizing defaults now scattered across GraphicParams/PlotCompiler.rowSize/legend specs, text-metrics-refined layout, and a user-facing plotting DSL for domain modules; create follow-on mote structure with dependencies and acceptance criteria; no implementation is required in this planning gate.
